correctness.rationale: Every one of the \(2^{14}\) subsets is checked by two separate membership predicates for component bounds 2 through 6. For bound 3 a complete acyclic 2310-pair matching has only one vertex and one 6-simplex critical, yielding \(S^6\). For successive bounds 3->4 and 4->5 actual free-pair collapses of lengths 784 and 840 are replayed on the full simplicial complexes, giving simple-homotopy equivalences of the NATURAL inclusions. Independent Euler counts -12,2,2,2,-19 prove sharpness. The stand-alone verification script reruns the entire finite certificate in seconds and requires no external mathematical engine.

value.rationale: A natural component-size filtration of the canonical Fano-plane incidence graph adds 1568 and then 1680 strict new simplices while preserving the *actual inclusion* simple-homotopy class through two full collapse certificates. The resulting \(S^6\) persistence across three stages is structurally stronger than identical Betti numbers or abstract homotopy types, and adjacent Euler changes prove the plateau is sharp. It supplies a motivated nonchordal comparison for existing higher-independence graph-family methods, not a routine parameter renaming.
